el.Recorremos pueblos de Sudamérica tocando: We travel through towns across South America, playing zambas, saya and folk music
el.Somos un dúo de música popular y folklór: We are a popular and folk music duo who decided to travel town by town through Bolivia, Uruguay, Brazil and Argentina. Four months in Bolivia, the squares of Cochabamba, the vineyards of Tarija, the streets of La Paz... every place gives us new stories and the desire to keep going.
el.Nuestras canciones están en todas las pl: Our songs are available on all platforms. "Enredados", "Pacto en Zamba", "De la Calle al Escenario"... music born on the road that stays in the heart of those who hear it.
